question: What totalizing claim is made about the field-group in relation to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: A single all-field group is assigned to them collectively.
inference: The all-field group belongs collectively to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
uncertainties: The structure of that field-group is not specified here.
plain_english: The all-field group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
